approved_payload.content: Police say a man of 33 was shot dead in Firethorne, near Geelhout Street, at about 23:05 on Saturday 17 October (Lieutenant Colonel FC van Wyk, provincial police spokesperson, via Athlone News). He was walking near a premises when a white vehicle stopped alongside him; the occupants allegedly opened fire and chased him until he collapsed. Bishop Lavis police found his body with gunshot wounds to the chest and head. Bishop Lavis detectives are investigating a murder case; police believe the motive is gang-related. No arrest has been reported. The victim was not named. One report found, resting on police: Athlone News, published 22 October. 'Firethorne' is not a suburb on the map; the pin is on Geelhout Road beside Firethorn Street in Bonteheuwel, an inferred location the article does not give. Not the Loganberry Street, Bonteheuwel, shooting of 18 October in the same article.

The pin is INFERRED: the midpoint of Geelhout Road, Bonteheuwel (OSM ways 704572595 and 30349364, about 448 m), which meets Firethorn Street (OSM way 30349369) at both ends of its loop, inside the Bishop Lavis police area per the 22 Oct source check. The spelling differs (Firethorn) and the article gives no street-level location; the point marks the area, not the scene. OSM 'Geelhout Street' in the Lotus River area (Ward 65) is a different street and is not used.
